name: Zevrost
summary: In Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow, Zevrost trains warlocks in fel magic. He guides Horde initiates through summoning rites and the handling of dark artifacts.

sections.title: Master of the Dark Arts
sections.body: In the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar, Zevrost is one of the chief mentors for Horde warlocks in Thrall’s capital. Orcs remain wary of fel magic after their past demonic corruption, so practitioners work under strict watch. Zevrost teaches the discipline needed to command demons without yielding to their corruption. He says fel ruins only those who lack inner strength.

sections.title: Guiding the Ambitious
sections.body: Zevrost guides warlocks beyond spells and curses, opening the way to greater dark undertakings. Initiates seeking advanced implements such as the Orb of Orahil, or the means to summon a fiery Felsteed, often come through his hands. He sends ambitious practitioners to other masters, including Menara Voidrender in the Barrens, so they can push their command of shadow magic to its limits.

faq.answer: Zevrost trains Horde warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He teaches incantations to novice and experienced practitioners and guides them through important class rituals.
Zevrost can be found in the Cleft of Shadow, a cavern beneath Orgrimmar’s main districts.

faq.q: Why are warlocks like Zevrost permitted in Orgrimmar?
aliases: why are warlocks allowed in orgrimmar
faq.answer: Thrall’s Horde permits warlocks to practice in the secluded Cleft of Shadow under strict watch. Orcs remember the corruption brought by demon blood, yet the Horde values the ruthless power warlocks can bring against its enemies.

faq.q: What is Zevrost's philosophy on demonic magic?
faq.answer: Zevrost believes dark and arcane energies corrupt only those who are weak of will. He urges his students to study with strict discipline, lest they succumb to the destructive forces they command.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you can learn advanced spells from Zevrost and be sent to seek specialized weapons, off-hands, and a fiery steed.
As an orc, you live among people who largely shun demonic magic. Zevrost represents practitioners who still wield the dark arts under the Warchief’s close scrutiny.
